reason: The posted daily cleaning log, shoes off and capped numbers are exactly what I look for, so I'd use the free visit and probably pay for a drop-in once on a rainy day. We'd go once or twice a month, so I'd never take the membership.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a membership. I also want to see real reviews and the place itself before I trust the cleaning claims.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the cleaning log and toy-sanitizing in person on the free visit, plus good reviews from other parents, would make me comfortable coming back regularly.
